'''Cy Krolo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked for [[Suudaa Nem'ro|Nem'ro the Hutt]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Stationed on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], he tasked an Imperial individual to head into Fa'athra's palace and activate a transmitter on a few cleaning droids so he could get information on the palace layout.
